frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Learning-to-forecast experiments: subjects coordinate within groups on simple trend-following/anchoring rules rather than the rational-expectations equilibrium, producing oscillations and bubbles; a Brock-Hommes heuristic-switching model with a few rules reproduces this rationally heterogeneous expectation formation.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Rationally Heterogeneous Expectations in Learning-to-Forecast
